---
name: Research hypothesis or counterexample
about: Improve a claim, baseline, experiment or falsification criterion
---

## Claim or work packet

Identify the hypothesis, invariant or packet and affected revision.

## Proposed change or counterexample

Explain the mechanism and relevant assumptions. Use synthetic or redacted inputs only.

## Test and falsification criterion

Specify matched-cost baselines, observable outcomes and what result would reject the proposal.

## Evidence and limits

Distinguish measured results from predictions. Link reproducible artifacts and state what remains untested.
